intuition: A cursor marks the first ID not yet emitted from the stream.

brute_force.approach: After each insertion, scan the entire buffer from the beginning to find the next contiguous chunk.

optimal.approach: Store values by ID and advance one cursor while the next ID has arrived.
optimal.time: insert O(k) for the newly released chunk

edge_cases: An insertion after a gap returns an empty list.
Several buffered values may be emitted when a gap is filled.
